class PortalUser < ApplicationRecord
  rolify role_join_table_name: "portal_users_portal_roles",
         role_cname: "PortalRole",
         role_table_name: "portal_roles"

  # Devise modules
  devise :database_authenticatable, :registerable,
         :recoverable, :rememberable, :validatable,
         :trackable

  # Associations
  has_many :sales_customers, class_name: "Customer", foreign_key: "sales_id"
  belongs_to :location, optional: true
  has_many :sales_orders, class_name: "Order", foreign_key: "sales_id"
  has_many :orders, foreign_key: "regular_user_id"
  has_one :customer, foreign_key: "regular_user_id"
  has_many :user_permissions, dependent: :destroy

  # Validations
  validates :name, presence: true
  validates :email,
            presence: true,
            uniqueness: { case_sensitive: false },
            format: { with: URI::MailTo::EMAIL_REGEXP }


  validate :password_complexity, if: :password_required?

  # Instance Methods

  def roles_list
    roles.pluck(:name).join(", ")
  end

  def created_at_formatted
    created_at.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
  end

  def generate_login_token!(expires_in = 1.month)
    self.login_token = SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(32)
    self.login_token_expired_at = Time.current + expires_in
    save!
  end

  def login_token_valid?
    login_token.present? && login_token_expired_at.present? && Time.current < login_token_expired_at
  end

  def invalidate_login_token!
    update!(login_token: nil, login_token_expired_at: nil)
  end

  def assign_single_role(role_name)
    return if role_name.blank?

    self.roles = [] if !has_role?(role_name) || roles.count > 1
    add_role(role_name)
  end

  def assign_role_after_creation(role)
    assign_single_role(role)
  end

  def update_single_role!(new_role)
    return if new_role.blank?
    return if has_role?(new_role) && roles.count == 1

    # send first login email to user
    AdminMailer.first_login_email(self).deliver_later

    self.roles = []
    add_role(new_role)
  end

  def last_admin?
    has_role?(:admin) && PortalUser.with_role(:admin).count <= 1
  end

  def self_deletion?(current_user)
    self == current_user
  end

  def dealer_name
    location&.name
  end

  def dealer_code
    location&.code
  end
  # custom inspect for debug
  def inspect
    puts "#<#{self.class.name}:0x#{object_id.to_s(16)}"
    attributes.each do |key, value|
      formatted_value = case value
      when String
        value.length > 100 ? "\"#{value[0..97]}...\"" : "\"#{value}\""
      when Time, DateTime, Date
        "\"#{value}\""
      when nil
        "nil"
      else
        value.inspect
      end
      puts "  #{key.ljust(20)}: #{formatted_value}"
    end
    puts ">"
    nil
  end

  # Caches a user's permissions to avoid multiple database queries per request
  def permissions_hash
    @permissions_hash ||= user_permissions.pluck(:resource_key, :access_level).to_h
  end

  # Checks if user has at least view-only access to a resource
  def can_view?(resource_key)
    permissions_hash[resource_key].in?([ "read", "write" ])
  end

  # Checks if user has full read-write access to a resource
  def can_edit?(resource_key)
    permissions_hash[resource_key] == "write"
  end

  private

  def password_complexity
    unless password =~ /^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\d)(?=.*[@$!%*?&()])[A-Za-z\d@$!%*?&()]{8,}$/
      errors.add :password, "must include at least one lowercase letter, one uppercase letter, one digit, one special character, and be at least 8 characters long"
    end
  end

  def password_required?
    password.present? || password_confirmation.present?
  end
end
